name: Electronic Concepts Inc
old_description: High Power AC Filtering with Series or Parallel Safety Options
about:
Electronic Concepts Inc. has operated from Eatontown, New Jersey since its founding in 1969. The veteran-owned small business also maintains a European office in Oughterard, County Galway, Ireland.

The company designs and manufactures film capacitors for energy storage, AC filtering, DC link, coupling/decoupling, snubber, inverter, frequency discriminating, resonant circuit, and high-temperature applications. Its product lines include the LH3 series with low ESL under 10 nH, the EV/HEV series for electric vehicles, and multiple high-temperature series rated above 105 °C. In-house capabilities span dielectric research, film capacitor manufacturing, testing, and a design center that offers application notes, technical papers, and interactive formula calculators. The firm also performs contract R&D for universities, private institutions, and government laboratories.

Electronic Concepts serves the aerospace sector (AS9100D certified), power electronics, electric vehicle, industrial power supply, and research communities. Its capacitors appear in inverter applications, resonant power circuits, switching power supplies, and high-power filtering. The company exhibits at IEEE ECCE, APEC, and PCIM conferences, and its R&D division collaborates with academic and government labs.

The company emphasizes low-inductance, high-current-carrying capability at elevated temperatures, and offers series or parallel safety options for high-power AC filtering. Its quality system includes AS9100D, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, DPRV certification, and UL recognition.
